verdict.rationale: Microsoft publishes an official MCP server for its Learn docs (probe-4), and the Entra docs are available as raw markdown in the public MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs GitHub repo (docs-13). Together these give agents a first-party way to consume the documentation. However, probes found no llms.txt at learn.microsoft.com and no .md variant of the docs pages (both returned 404). Missing for 10: an llms.txt index, .md-suffixed docs pages on the docs site, Entra-specific agent-oriented documentation guidance, and hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
